steamShortDescription.value: Sudoku with alien glyphs instead of numbers. Clear a 54-level campaign, keep a daily streak, and race a customizable computer rival in Alien Duel, with a theme song for every difficulty from cozy lo-fi to legendary war drums.

fullDescription.value:
Decode the hieroglyphs of the lost UFO archive.

Alien Sudoku is classic sudoku with a cosmic twist. Instead of digits you place nine alien glyphs, and each one must appear exactly once in every row, every column and every 3×3 box. The rules you know, with a whole new look.

FEATURES
• 54-level campaign across 6 sectors, from the Lunar Outpost to the Cluster Core, with stars to earn and new glyph lineups to unlock
• Daily Transmission: a new puzzle every day, with a streak calendar
• Alien Duel: race a computer rival on the same puzzle. Choose from four rivals, from a sleepy rookie to the relentless Maw, then rename it and tune its speed, accuracy and play style
• Quick Play, plus a relaxing Zen mode with no lives, no clock and unlimited hints
• 1,000 puzzles in four difficulties, each with exactly one solution
• Every difficulty brings its own aliens, from friendly Soft Visitors on Easy to the fearsome Gnarly Horde on Alien
• A theme song for every difficulty, from cozy lo-fi to legendary war drums
• Smart hints that explain why a glyph goes where it does
• Notes, auto-notes, undo, combos and score bonuses
• 33 achievements and detailed stats
• Run out of tries and the visitors arrive. Their ship rises from the horizon and asks who you are...
• Plays offline. No account needed.

Easy to learn, hard to master, and out of this world.
fullDescription.note: Wording is kept neutral (no 'cuddly', 'baby'): Google Play's Families policy looks at whether a listing appeals to children, and this game is rated 13+ with ads.

mobileAdsLine.value: Free to play with ads. Watching a short video for an extra hint or a second chance is always optional.
mobileAdsLine.note: Add to the end of the description on Google Play and the App Store only.

pcLine.value: No ads, no microtransactions. Plays offline on Windows, macOS and Linux.
pcLine.note: Add to the end of the description on Steam, GOG, itch.io, Epic and Microsoft Store.

whatsNew.value: First release. The lost UFO archive is open: decode it!
